product_overview: The Solitario is a premium lab-grown diamond jewellery e‑commerce platform (headless Shopify + Next.js) delivering discovery → cart → payment → shipping flows with Clerk authentication and Razorpay payments. (See Product Overview on page 4 of the PRD for full context.)
core_goals: Deliver a premium, brand-consistent shopping experience for lab-grown diamond jewellery (PRD page 4).
Support end-to-end commerce: browse → cart → payment → shipping → delivery confirmation (PRD pages 6, 12, 13, 14).
Maximize conversion with promotions, fast UX (React Query caching, infinite scroll), and frictionless checkout (PRD pages 8, 17).
Provide secure accounts and admin operations via Clerk and an admin panel for order/promotions management (PRD pages 11, 16).
Ensure accurate logistics and tracking via Delhivery and transactional emails via Resend (PRD pages 14, 17).

features.name: Homepage
features.description: Landing page with hero banner, featured product collections, promotional marquee and quick navigation into shop and campaigns (see Public Pages table on page 7).
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View hero banner and promotional content -> Browse featured product collections -> Click on a product card -> Navigate to /products/[handle]
Navigate to / -> Open mobile menu -> Tap Featured products carousel -> Carousel fails to load (API error) -> See fallback promotional content or error message

features.name: Product Browsing (Shop)
features.description: Shop page listing all products with grid layout, category filters, search and infinite scroll. Data sourced from /api/products (see Shop page and Product System on pages 7 and 10).
user_flows: Navigate to /products -> View all products in a grid layout -> Filter products by category -> See filtered product list -> Click on a product card -> Navigate to /products/[handle]
Navigate to /products -> Enter search query in search modal or search field -> Submit search -> See 'No products found' message when there are zero matches

features.name: Product Detail Page (PDP)
features.description: Individual product page with image gallery, description, variant selection, Add to Cart and Buy Now actions; uses /api/products/[handle] for product data (see PDP on page 7 and Product Features on page 10).
user_flows: Navigate to /products/[handle] -> View product images in gallery -> Read product description and specs -> Select product variant (size or color) -> Click Add to Cart button -> See item added confirmation and header cart count updated
Navigate to /products/[handle] -> Select a variant with zero inventory -> Click Add to Cart -> See out-of-stock error message and disable Add to Cart

features.name: Authentication (Sign In / Sign Up)
features.description: Clerk-based authentication with Email/Password and Google OAuth; on first sign-in a Shopify customer is auto-created (see Auth section on page 11).
user_flows: Navigate to /sign-up -> Click sign up button -> Enter email and password -> Click sign up -> See account created and redirect to /account and observe Shopify customer created
Navigate to /sign-in -> Enter email and incorrect password -> Click sign in button -> See authentication error message

features.name: Shopping Cart
features.description: Dual cart system: client-side local cart for instant updates and server-synced Shopify cart for checkout integrity; cart page available at /cart (see Cart & Checkout on page 12).
user_flows: Navigate to /products/[handle] -> Click Add to Cart -> Navigate to /cart -> View cart items -> Update item quantity -> See cart total recalculated -> Click Proceed to Checkout -> Navigate to /checkout
Navigate to /cart -> Update item quantity to a number exceeding available inventory -> See validation error 'Quantity exceeds available stock' and quantity update prevented

features.name: Checkout
features.description: Multi-step checkout at /checkout with address input, pincode (Delhivery) serviceability check, coupon application, Razorpay payment modal and server-side signature verification (see Checkout Flow on page 12 and Payments on page 13).
user_flows: Navigate to /cart -> Click Proceed to Checkout -> Navigate to /checkout -> Fill address fields -> Click Continue -> See pincode serviceability check call and ETA -> Apply coupon code -> Click Pay -> Razorpay modal opens -> Complete payment successfully -> See redirect to /checkout/success

Navigate to /cart -> Click Proceed to Checkout -> Navigate to /checkout -> Fill address fields -> Click Pay -> Razorpay modal opens -> User cancels or payment fails -> Razorpay callback indicates failure -> See redirect to /checkout/failed with retry option

features.name: Wishlist
features.description: Save products for later in the wishlist accessible at /wishlist; wishlist persists with live price refresh from Shopify (see User Account Features on page 11).
user_flows: Navigate to /products -> Click Add to Wishlist on a product card -> Navigate to /wishlist -> View saved wishlist items with live prices -> Click Add to Cart on wishlist item -> Navigate to /cart
Navigate to /products -> Click Add to Wishlist while signed out -> See login popup triggered and prompt to /sign-in or /sign-up

features.name: Contact Form
features.description: Contact page at /contact with inquiry form and POST /api/contact; form triggers a confirmation message and emails the internal team (see Contact Form on page 7 and Email System on page 17).
user_flows: Navigate to /contact -> Fill name, email, and message fields -> Click Submit -> See confirmation message and backend /api/contact POST success
Navigate to /contact -> Leave required field (email) blank -> Click Submit -> See inline validation error for the missing/invalid email

features.name: Account Dashboard
features.description: Protected user account at /account for profile, addresses, orders, payment methods and wishlist; protected via Clerk middleware (see User Account Pages on pages 7–8 and Auth on page 11).
user_flows: Navigate to /sign-in -> Sign in successfully -> Navigate to /account -> View profile overview and quick stats -> Click Order History -> See list of past orders
Navigate to /account while signed out -> See redirect to /sign-in or login popup and cannot access protected content

features.name: Admin Panel
features.description: Protected admin area at /admin for dashboard, orders, products and promotions; requires Clerk session + admin role check (see Admin Panel on page 16).
user_flows: Sign in as admin -> Navigate to /admin -> View key metrics dashboard -> Click Orders -> Open order details -> Update order status -> See status saved
Sign in as non-admin user -> Navigate to /admin -> See access denied or role-check failure message and no admin UI rendered

features.name: Store Locator
features.description: Store locator at /stores with Google Maps integration, city-based search and store details (see Store Locator on page 21).
user_flows: Navigate to /stores -> Enter a city in the search field -> See list of stores and embedded map -> Click a store -> View address, hours and Get Directions link
Navigate to /stores -> Search for a city outside coverage -> See 'No stores found' message

features.name: Warner Bros Collectibles Landing
features.description: Themed campaign landing page at /warner-bros with rotating hero banners, brand filters and a persistent floating WB button (see Warner Bros section on page 22).
user_flows: Navigate to /warner-bros -> View rotating hero banners -> Click DC brand filter -> See filtered product collection -> Click a product -> Navigate to /products/[handle]
Navigate to /warner-bros -> Floating WB button fails to load -> Click fallback link to shop collection -> Navigate to /products?collection=warnerbros and see alternative content

features.name: Promotions & Coupons
features.description: Promotion engine supports Buy 2 Get 1 Free, first-purchase discounts, loyalty coupons and Shopify-native discount codes; coupon validation endpoints exist (see Promotions on page 15 and API Routes on page 27–28).
user_flows: Add three eligible items to cart -> Navigate to /cart -> Observe Buy 2 Get 1 Free auto-applied and subtotal updated -> Proceed to /checkout -> See discount reflected in order summary
On /checkout -> Enter coupon code and submit -> Server-side validation returns invalid/expired -> See coupon validation error and discount not applied
